summary: The same pipeline with the notification rule limited to the uploads/ prefix, uploads stored under uploads/, and the sidecar written under meta/. Each user may keep at most 100 clips, checked against an R2 listing before the upload, and every upload must state its length.

must_not_flag.reason: Uploads are kept, but each user can hold at most 100 clips (MAX_CLIPS_PER_USER) of at most 25 MB, and uploads without a Content-Length are refused. R2 listings through a Worker binding are strongly consistent, so the count is not per location; uploads that pass the check at the same moment can overshoot it, by at most what the per-location rate limit lets through at once. One account stores at most about 2.5 GB plus 100 small sidecars, about $0.04 a month at R2's storage rate. Rate the path by what one account unlocks.

The rule in scripts/setup.sh covers only keys under uploads/. The sidecar is written under meta/, which the rule does not match, and the consumer returns early for any key outside uploads/, so its own output cannot raise another event. One upload costs one message, one R2 read and one R2 write.
